mapper.select: SELECT s.district AS name, ROUND(COALESCE(s.carbon_reduction, 0), 0) AS `value` FROM stad_carbon_statistics s INNER JOIN ( SELECT district, MAX(stat_date) AS max_date FROM stad_carbon_statistics GROUP BY district ) latest ON s.district = latest.district AND s.stat_date = latest.max_date ORDER BY s.district

SELECT s.district AS name, COALESCE(s.total_nev_count, 0) AS `value` FROM stad_carbon_statistics s INNER JOIN ( SELECT district, MAX(stat_date) AS max_date FROM stad_carbon_statistics GROUP BY district ) latest ON s.district = latest.district AND s.stat_date = latest.max_date ORDER BY s.district

SELECT st.district AS name, COUNT(*) AS `value` FROM stad_charging_pile p LEFT JOIN stad_charging_station st ON p.station_id = st.station_id WHERE st.district IS NOT NULL GROUP BY st.district ORDER BY st.district

SELECT COALESCE(SUM(s.total_nev_count), 0) FROM stad_carbon_statistics s INNER JOIN ( SELECT district, MAX(stat_date) AS max_date FROM stad_carbon_statistics GROUP BY district ) latest ON s.district = latest.district AND s.stat_date = latest.max_date

SELECT COALESCE(SUM(s.carbon_reduction), 0) FROM stad_carbon_statistics s INNER JOIN ( SELECT district, MAX(stat_date) AS max_date FROM stad_carbon_statistics GROUP BY district ) latest ON s.district = latest.district AND s.stat_date = latest.max_date
